tagline: Cook seasonally with what's growing: recipes, pantry knowledge and kitchen crafts
description: RUBIY is a guide for seasonal cooking in Germany: What grows in spring, summer, autumn and winter, how to store it, preserve it and prepare it, with tried-and-tested recipes, seasonal calendars and kitchen knowledge for every day.
author: RUBIY kitchen editorial team
